name: Autobahn
description: A point-to-point run down thirty kilometres of German motorway, built to the real thing's dimensions — lane widths, markings and barriers all to size. The AI keeps the Rechtsfahrgebot, holding the right-hand lane and passing only on the left, which is what makes it traffic rather than a rolling roadblock.
